method_delta: Exhaustive equal-weight finite exogenous enumeration replaces Monte Carlo seeds to remove sampling error in this fully finite authored SCM. The same causal contrasts, cases, assumptions, and fail-closed objective are retained.
estimand: Interventional mediator-distribution contrast under outcome route A=1 and its L distribution: psi(g1)-psi(g0), with D baseline-standardized and M distribution g_a(m|D,L) drawn from route a. This is not a natural indirect effect.
naive_comparator: Same contrast but omitting post-assignment L from mediator and outcome models; standardize only over D.

h_t_d_c_u.H: Longitudinal standardization recovers the finite interventional mediator-distribution contrast when the declared identification conditions hold; positivity failure is reported without a point estimate; naive omission of exposure-induced mediator-outcome confounding can invent a pathway; observationally identical hidden-confounding models remain nonidentified.
h_t_d_c_u.T: Exhaustively enumerate four 384-row binary SCM cases, hidden observational-equivalence models, randomized mediator intervention positive control, and a separate factorial interaction; compare longitudinal g-formula, naive baseline-only contrast, and structural oracle.
h_t_d_c_u.D: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only when the independent exact-count auditor reconstructs all rows and estimands, identification statuses match, controls equal frozen values, and all six mutation controls are rejected; preserve any first failure without retry.
h_t_d_c_u.C: Finite authored equations and comparator behavior may not generalize; exact enumeration removes Monte Carlo error only for these fixtures.
h_t_d_c_u.U: Synthetic causal-method evidence only; no empirical exchangeability, real-world mediation, human, product, GUI, model, or live-action inference.

hidden_confounding_pair.support: U=0..39 equally weighted independently of A
hidden_confounding_pair.causal_mediation_model: rm=u mod 4; ry=floor(u/4); m=1 iff rm < (1 if a=0 else 3); y=m XOR (ry=0)
hidden_confounding_pair.hidden_common_cause_model: A-specific U lookup yields identical observed (A,M,Y) counts, but M and Y are both functions of U and A; intervention on M does not alter Y

authority: NONE; no action or task authority is modeled
execution_scope: stdlib Python, deterministic exhaustive CPU enumeration; no network/model/GUI/OS input/container
